svg.title: Policies trained only on human demos: reaching the basket vs. finishing the task
svg.desc: Grouped bars per condition. 30-trial evaluation: approached the basket C0 13, C1 24, C2 30; lifted 6, 6, 3; completed 1, 1, 0. 45-trial evaluation: approached 31, 19, 41; completed 6, 0, 0.

g.text: Policies trained only on human demos: reaching the basket vs. finishing the task

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: Anchoring the base plan to the basket gets the robot to it almost every time, but lifting does not improve, so full-task success does not either.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: Simulation only: RB-Y1 basket carry in a MuJoCo scene built by Chuye Zhang. Policies trained on 53-60 egocentric human demonstrations, no robot data. Bar labels are trial counts.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: Stages are cumulative from the same rollouts. C0 and C1 also differ in training-data build.
